title: Pairwise Separation and Compactness in Soft Bitopological Spaces via Soft Elements
summary: Let $F\colon A\to\mathcal P(X)$ be a soft set, and let $SE(F)$ be the set of all maps $a\colon A\to X$ such that $a(t)\in F(t)$, for every $t\in A$. If $τ$ is a soft topology on $F$, the sets $SE(H)$, where $H\inτ$, form a basis for an ordinary topology $τ^{\mathrm e}$ on $SE(F)$, called the \emph{induced soft-element topology}. Hence, two soft topologies on $F$ induce a bitopological space on $SE(F)$. We define pairwise soft $T_0$, $T_1$, and $T_2$ axioms using soft elements and prove that they are equivalent to the corresponding pairwise axioms of the induced soft-element bitopological…
